nodes.label: <Goal G0>
nodes.text: The user is aware of camera malfunction

nodes.label: <Goal G1>
nodes.text: Camera malfunctions are detected by runtime monitors in a timely fashion

nodes.label: <Goal G2>
nodes.text: Camera malfunctions are mitigated by redundancy of components

nodes.label: <Goal G3>
nodes.text: The system alerts the user when Camera malfunctions occur

nodes.label: <Strategy>
nodes.text: Argue that the system provides the user with awareness of camera malfunctions

nodes.label: <Strategy-2>
nodes.text: Argue that the runtime monitor detects Camera malfunctions every 10 seconds

nodes.label: <Strategy-3>
nodes.text: Argue that appropriate redundant Camera components are available for use when needed

nodes.label: <Strategy-4>
nodes.text: Argue that effective runtime user alerts are generated

nodes.label: <Solution S1>
nodes.text: The runtime monitor checks that the camera is functioning every 5 seconds

nodes.label: <Solution S2>
nodes.text: When a camera malfunction occurs an effective user alert is raised

nodes.label: <Solution S3>
nodes.text: The downward facing camera is activated and used when primary search camera fails

nodes.label: <Solution S4>
nodes.text: Best practices for designing for situational awareness have been applied
